title: U.S. 69 (Hwy 77) and General Cavazos Blvd.

rows.label: Location
rows.text: The property is located near the southwest corner of Highway 77 and E. General Cavazos Blvd. on the southeast side of Kingsville.

rows.label: Utilities
pairs: AEP lines are present along the highway frontage
City of Kingsville, just north of the site
City of Kingsville, just north of the site
rows.note: Prospective buyers should retain an independent engineer to verify the location, accessibility and capacity of all utilities.

rows.label: Zoning
rows.text: The property is zoned AG Agricultural, City of Kingsville.
rows.note: Prospective buyers should verify the zoning and permitted uses for this property with the appropriate governing authority.

rows.label: Flood Plain
rows.text: According to FEMA maps, floodplain does not appear to be on the property.

rows.label: Topography
rows.text: The site has a gentle slope. Drainage is to the southwest. See Site Plan.

rows.label: Easements
rows.text: Utility easements are on the property.

rows.label: Traffic Count
rows.text: Texas Department of Transportation 2024 maps indicate 20,534 vehicles per day on Highway 77, north of the property and 14,622 vehicles per day on General Chavos Blvd, north of the property.

rows.label: Demographics
rows.note: Source: U.S. Bureau of the Census, 2020 Census of Population and Housing. ESRI forecasts for 2025 and 2030.

rows.label: Area Development
rows.text: The property is adjacent to Christus Spon Hospital Kleberg. Other stores at or near the intersection include: Wal-Mart, McDonald’s, Chick-Fil-a, Starbucks, Whataburger, Chili’s, Wendy’s and others.

rows.label: Potential Uses
rows.text: The property has many potential uses including restaurant, car wash, bank, and other commercial uses.

comments: Great pad site with access in rear to Librado Drive
The property is at one of Kingsville’s major commercial intersections.
It has excellent visibility and accessibility from Hwy 77 / U.S. 69.

qa_notes: ZONING CONTRADICTION: spec says 'The property is zoned AG Agricultural, City of Kingsville.' (Prismic 'AG - Agricultural' agrees), but the 2017 survey (p8) note 4 says 'ENTIRE TRACT IS ZONED "C2"' and the 2017 site plan (p7) says 'EXISTING ZONING: AG, PROPOSED ZONING: C2'. The site may have been rezoned C2 - broker should verify before publishing.
TYPO: Traffic Count says 'General Chavos Blvd' (should be General Cavazos). Kept as printed.
TYPO: Area Development says 'Christus Spon Hospital Kleberg' (the hospital is Christus Spohn; the survey inset map labels it '...pohn Kleberg'). Also 'Chick-Fil-a' casing. Kept as printed.
TRANSACTION: the PDF never says 'For Sale' or 'For Lease' (cover 'COMMERCIAL PAD SITE OPPORTUNITY'; Investment 'Contact Broker'); set to 'For Sale' by default. Prismic transaction_type is null.

TITLE: PDF cover prints 'U.S. 69 (HWY 77) AND GENERAL CAVAZOS BLVD.'; Prismic title is 'Highway 77 at General Cavazos Blvd., Kingsville'; the Demographic Overview is titled 'HIGHWAY 77 AT GENERAL CAVAZOS BLVD, KINGSVILLE, TX'. Transcribed the cover wording.
SIZE: '1.148 +/- Acres' matches the survey ('1.148 ACRES (50,000 SQ. FT. MORE OR LESS)') and Prismic acres 1.148. Frontage 'Approximately 203 feet' vs survey 203.66'.
CONTACT: this package lists Matt Howard first ('MATT HOWARD or BART WILSON') and his email first; kept in printed order.
SITE PLAN (p7) is a 2017 Pape-Dawson plan for a proposed Bill Miller Bar-B-Q restaurant - a prior buyer's concept; worth confirming the broker still wants it in the package.

Spec demographics (4,151 / 19,932 / 26,229; 4,033 / 19,310 / 25,513; $94,714 / $76,516 / $76,334) match the Demographic Overview. Overview dated December 5, 2025 (others in this batch are September 2025). Owner+renter columns sum exactly to 2025 Households.
Aerials (pp5-6) carry the map tool's placeholder subtitle 'Texas, AC +/-' with no acreage filled in.

Prismic highlights paraphrase the comments ('One of Kingsville's major commercial intersections', 'Excellent visibility and accessibility from Hwy 77 / U.S. 69'); Prismic price 'Contact Broker' matches.
